title: To Determine the Effect of Forlax® Treatment in Children With Chronic Constipation Who May Also Suffer From Soiling/ Faecal Incontinence.
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether Forlax® is more effective than placebo in relieving chronic constipation in children who may also suffer from soiling or faecal incontinence.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Chronic constipation (defined as at least 3 months of less than 2 bowel movements (BMs) per week and/or one of the following symptoms : hard stool, painful defecation, encopresis)
* Constipation previously treated by dietary advice (high fiber diet) for at least two weeks without efficacy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Organic bowel diseases
* Suspected GI obstruction
* History of GI surgery
